title: 1996 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement: The pie charts below indicate the percent of students who prefer golf, bowling, or tennis at East Junior High School and West Middle School. The total number of students at East is \(2000\) and at West, \(2500.\) In the two schools combined, the percent of students who prefer tennis is

solutions.text:
East has \(0.22 \cdot 2000 = 440\) tennis fans, and West has \(0.40 \cdot 2500 = 1000.\)

Together \(1440\) of the \(4500\) students prefer tennis, which is \(\dfrac{1440}{4500} = 32\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Find the actual number of tennis fans at each school, not just the percents
Add the two counts and divide by the total of \(4500\) students
